agent_reported_regressions.evidence: Agent tool transcripts; standalone focused logs were not retained. Test source hash and implementation commit are pinned above; the independent full-suite record is persisted separately.

frozen_campaign.scope: Original generation campaigns continue with their frozen implementation; no observations are replaced with the lazy implementation or its diagnostic counts.

implementation.api_contract: Catalog.fps is an insertion-ordered mutable mapping, not a concrete dict. Key iteration, membership and length do not compute values. Value reads, iteration over items/values, and copy materialize requested fingerprints. Catalog molecules are a fixed snapshot; post-load mutation of those molecules is outside the contract.
implementation.behavior: The full catalog and import provenance are eagerly validated. Each eligible structure fingerprint is computed when first read, using the fingerprint generator captured at catalog construction and a per-instance cache.

independent_full_suite.runtime_scope: Previously validated isolated CPU runtime; not a CUDA validation
independent_full_suite.source_resolution: cwd and PYTHONPATH point to the isolated implementation worktree; exact original command/environment are bound by the metadata artifact hash.

independent_real_subset_validation.counter_scope: Search and fully-materialized totals include query fingerprints as well as catalog fingerprints. Counts describe avoided/deferred work for this subset, not measured time or memory savings.
independent_real_subset_validation.limitation: This checks a sampled catalog subset and retained routes, not full-catalog behavioral equivalence over every possible search. No new model inference or experimental synthesis validation.
independent_real_subset_validation.search_design: 20 sampled reaction roles and 10 sampled catalog queries; varied top-k, similarity thresholds and required-role intersections.
independent_real_subset_validation.selection: 768 catalog row indices sampled with random.Random(20261016), plus required blocks for the first 16 SHA-sorted unique routes in successful retained GPU0/GPU1 outputs; union 795 rows.

pre_change_profile.interpretation: Instrumented pre-change CPU attribution only. Timer overhead is included; MolFromSmiles time is nested in strict-molecule validation and must not be added twice. Wall time includes nice-19 low-priority scheduling. No post-change full-catalog timing or memory measurement was made.

publication_limits: No supplier catalog rows, molecular route graphs or private subset are bundled.
Local evidence reports, logs and assessment scripts are hash-bound but not bundled; this compact record alone is not a self-contained replay of the real-data checks.
No post-change full-catalog speedup, campaign-throughput or memory-reduction estimate is established.
Independent full-suite validation used the isolated CPU runtime; it is not CUDA validation.
scope: Lazy catalog fingerprint construction; one pre-change full-catalog profile, independent old/new behavior checks on a real subset, and software regression tests. No measured post-change speedup or memory reduction.
